'''Sector GL5''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Underworld]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the location of the murder of [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]] of the [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]] by a [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|Death Watch assassin]].
